args.title: Fix CSV export to handle multiple currencies correctly
args.body: Issue 4206 reports that the CSV export in src/export/csv.ts incorrectly merges transactions with the same date, amount, and description when they have different currencies (e.g., one in EUR and the other in USD). This results in only one transaction being exported to the CSV file, losing important information. The proposed change will adjust the CSV writing logic to ensure that each transaction is handled separately, even if they share the same date, amount, and description, thereby preserving all relevant transaction data regardless of currency.
